fixtures_note: Live captures of Mentor Practice 2 (comp 179) plus synthetic fixtures; see fixture_sources per case.

cases.title: One focus layer: no demo on it; the move turn (turn 3) walks through in words and ends on one offer of a watch on another layer; a later ask to see it on Door gets no demo and no second offer

rubric.reason: Turn 3 ends on the single sentence "I could show you on Needle first, if you like.", which names only the layer and not its place, runs nothing, and is not repeated in turn 4.

No demo is run; turns 2–3 walk through it in words (select Door, press Y, drag from Door's crosshair to the middle of its left edge, "so Door stays put"), turn 4 says "If I moved Door's pivot, there'd be nothing left for you to set", and no second watch offer is made.
Door, Needle, Anchor Point and Position, and Door's pivot "at its center", all match the tool results (focus, watch_offer.layer, place_now Door: center).
Turn 3 ends on a single offer sentence naming only the layer ('I could show you on Needle first, if you like.') with nothing after it, and turn 4 makes no second offer.

Turn 3 walks through in words (press Y, start the drag on Door's crosshair, take it to the middle of its left edge, 'Door stays put'), and turn 4 declines the demo ('If I moved Door's pivot myself, there'd be nothing left for you to set') with no demo and no second watch offer.
Door, Needle, Anchor Point and Position all appear in tool results, 'middle of its left edge' matches places Door: middle-left, and 'pivot is at its center' matches place_now Door: center.

Turn 3's invite turn ends on exactly one offer sentence, "I could show you on Needle first, if you like.", which names only the layer, not its place. Nothing follows it, nothing ran, and turn 4 makes no second offer.

No demo was run. Turn 3 walks through Y, starting the drag on Door's crosshair, taking it to the middle of the left edge, and Door staying put. Turn 4 says that if it moved Door's pivot there'd be nothing left for the learner, repeats the steps and makes no second watch offer.
Every name the mentor uses appears in the tool results: Door, Needle, Anchor Point, Position, Door's pivot at its center (place_now) and the middle of its left edge (places: middle-left).
